name: BG Wagon N Sixxy SI 87
sire: By PYC PAINT YOUR WAGON SI 107 (2003). 7 wins, $889,581 [G1]. Sire of 1,105 ROM, 132 stakes winners, $44,636,159, 5 champions, including HOOKED N GONE SI 106 (Champion, $893,176 [G1]), THE FISCAL CLIFF SI 109 (Champion, $580,425 [G1]). Sire of the dams of 86 stakes winners, including champions APOLLITICAL GOLD SI 96 ($1,014,601 [G1]), TRUMP MY RECORD SI 104 ($979,068 [G1]), UNRELENTLESS SI 102 ($495,702 [G1]), and of FIRST VALIANT SIGN SI 99 ($1,053,844 [G1]), DOLLAR BILL SI 106 ($650,581 [RG1]), TACHAS SECRET SI 104.

dam1.head: BG WIRED N SIXXY (br/t), by CRM Livewire. 2 wins, $15,571, Rocky Mountain Classic P&A Futurity, Jerome County Fair Futurity, 2nd Cassia County Fair Futurity, 3rd Pocatello Downs Futurity, and 3rd in an Elko County Fair Stakes. Dam of 3 APHA foals (1 tobiano). This is her oldest foal.

dam2.head: Hot N Sixxy, by A Dash Of Beduino. Unraced. Dam of 3 AQHA foals, all unraced, and 1 APHA foal– BG WIRED N SIXXY (f. by CRM Livewire). Stakes winner, above.

dam3.head: Streakin For Sue, by Streakin Six. Unplaced in 2 starts. Dam of 6 AQHA foals and 3 APHA foals (1 tobiano), all unraced.   4th dam Joelles Darling SI 93, by On A High. 3 wins at 3, $10,212. Sister to MOONS HIGH SI 101 ($570,799, Rainbow Derby [G1]); half sister to Moons Ego SI 102 ($36,213). APHA tobiano producer. Dam of 3 other AQHA foals to race, including–

items.text: Game Royale SI 91 (Game Patriot). Winner at 4, $16,003.

notes: Finalist in Speedhorse P&A Futurity at Fair Meadows [G1]. In training.
